security_privacy_cost_impact: No code, credential, schema, policy, CI or lockfile changes. The RFC sets security rules for later packages: the request path runs as authenticated on the user's JWT and the boundary is the database's grants to authenticated, with no server exemption (§2.7/1); session cookies are HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax (§2.7/1, §8/7); the service-role key is in no Vercel environment and no file under apps/ or src/ (§2.7/2); the worker credential and the Cron secret live only in the separate apps/worker Vercel project, are set only after Q-028-3 is answered, and the dispatcher compares its secret in constant time, fails closed and refuses on Preview (§2.7/3, §2.8); no Preview deployment holds a database credential of any environment (§2.4); install scripts never run, resolution is registry-only with integrity, versions are exact, no .npmrc exists, and a version enters the lockfile only after seven days on the registry (§4); Sentry runs with sendDefaultPii false, scrubbing in the browser and the server configuration including URLs that may carry one-time tokens, IP storage off, no Session Replay (§2.10). Cost: Vercel Pro with two Vercel projects (web and worker) and two Supabase Pro projects, opened by the Owner; Sentry is a subprocessor owed a PRV-001 entry.
migration_and_data_impact: None. db/foundation/migrations is unchanged and is declared the single migration source.
compatibility_impact: No contract changes. No toolchain change: Node 24.20.0 and npm 11.19.0 stay pinned.
known_limitations: Until WP-1A-A0-002 adds the §8 checks, RFC-2026-029 is held by review alone; the RFC says so.
